goal: compare idle drain with automatic sync off vs on, device unplugged

setup.connection: adb over Wi-Fi at 192.168.0.25:5555 (USB data cable unplugged; USB adb drops when unplugged)
setup.meter: battery charge counter (uAh) sampled every 60 s, plus level and temperature

conclusion: the two runs are NOT comparable: screen state differed, and the screen dominates the drain. The numbers must not be presented as a sync-overhead measurement.
operational_findings: unplugging the USB cable removes the USB adb path, so a wireless path is required for on-battery work
wireless adb dropped when the device entered Doze after the screen turned off
the device locked behind a PIN entry screen, which blocks scripted interaction
next_options: keep the device unlocked with a long screen timeout and run two 10-minute screen-on windows back to back
or report two battery-percentage readings by hand while using the device normally; the script accepts --reading 'HH:MM level'
